Field name

DetectId
Deprecated. This field is scheduled to be removed October 1, 2024.
Use the CompositeId field instead.
Unique identifier for the XDR detection
CompositeId
Unique identifier for the XDR detection
ScheduledSearchId
Unique identifier of the associated scheduled search
ScheduledSearchUserUUID
UUID of the user that created the the associated scheduled search
ScheduledSearchUserId
User ID of the user that created the the associated scheduled search
ScheduledSearchExecutionId
ID of the specific search execution
Severity
Standard 0-100 severity for the XDR detection. Can be overridden by custom XDR detections generated from an XDR
scheduled search.
Name
Name of the associated scheduled search, or name for the CrowdStrike XDR detection
PatternId
The numerical ID of the pattern associated with the action taken on the detection
Description
Description of the associated scheduled search
TacticIds
All TacticID values associated with the detection, including indicators
TechniqueIds
All TechniqueID values associated with the detection, including indicators
Author
Indicates whether the detection was generated by CrowdStrike or by a custom XDR detection (Custom Query)
DataDomains
Data domains of the event that was the primary indicator or created it
XdrType
Type of detection: xdr or xdr-scheduled-search
